title: Align automatic clip review with preservation of existing page summaries
notes: In the 2026-11-24 validation of Codex synthesis at b843765, a retained draft preserved the existing title and summary byte for byte. The automatic reviewer cited the unchanged summary as one reason to escalate, alongside citation and link concerns.
done_when: An otherwise acceptable addition to an existing page can pass automatic review with its summary unchanged. Citation and link checks still apply.
